facts.fact: CPJ says Kenya's 2018 Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act took effect after a 2020 High Court ruling, with October amendments giving a national cybercrime committee power to ban sites and apps.
Journalist Peter Mwita was charged in a Mombasa court under the cybercrimes law over a WhatsApp message and pleaded not guilty; CPJ lists other bloggers and journalists arrested under it.
